note: doc_type modificacion: the resolution 'modifica las condiciones de la Resolucion de 15 de junio de 2015 ... por la que se formula declaracion de impacto ambiental'. Operative sentence: 'Resuelve la modificacion de la condicion 5.3 del proyecto Instalacion fotovoltaica Don Rodrigo de 150 MW ... al concurrir el supuesto de la letra c) del apartado 1 del articulo 44'. It rewrites one condition (vegetation control, allows a localised herbicide and spring mowing) and decides nothing about the project itself, so verdict is no_aplica. developer: 'escrito de Free Mountain Systems, SL, promotor del proyecto'. mw_nominal: the only capacity printed is '150 MW' in the project name (title and operative sentence), not qualified as nominal or peak, so it is labelled as the project total; no mw_peak, hectares or turbines are stated and those fields are omitted. Municipalities: 'terminos municipales de Utrera y Alcala de Guadaira (Sevilla)' host the plant; no evacuation line is described. No expediente number is printed.
